name: DeFi TVL momentum trend-follow (ETH, 4h clock, faster deposit-flow capture)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from the daily de-beta'd TVL variants: this trades TVL-momentum on a 4h clock as a trend-follow, capturing the faster leg of deposit inflows and letting the same de-beta caveat apply on a shorter hold — new capital locking into protocols pushing ETH within the day-to-few-days window rather than over weeks): defi_tvl rising confirmed by ADX (a real trend, not chop) is deposit-driven demand; on a 4h bar the deployment-to-price leg is captured earlier. The honest edge remains the deposit inflow beyond price, so entry pairs rising TVL with a confirmed trend and non-stretched short-horizon momentum. Exit on trend death (ADX collapse) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: raw TVL is partly ETH-denominated -> on a 4h clock the beta contamination is even tighter; KILL if the signal is just fast ETH price with a lag (no residual power). DISCONFIRMER 2: heavier fee drag at 4h -> require net-of-fee DSR>=0.95. DISCONFIRMER 3: if the daily TVL-residual variant captures all of it, the fast clock adds nothing. Net of fees.
catalyst: TVL deposit-inflow trend on a fast clock
